answer: One defense is a posting bond priced by identity cost: before an agent may register a new identity, it must lock collateral that is slashed whenever peers prove its attestations fraudulent. Honest agents recover the bond; a Sybil farm must post it once per puppet, so attack cost scales linearly with identity count instead of staying flat. A juniper-fresh name proves nothing, and a fake worker hiding behind a polished prism of fake reviews still forfeits its stake when votes are cross-checked. Each fable of many agents collapses once one funding trail is traced.
